rca of the issue: Root cause of blank founder monogram: /app/frontend/public/brand-kit/team/riya-shaikh.svg contained the raw character `&` inside `aria-label="Riya Shaikh — Founder & Managing Director"`. SVG is served as image/svg+xml which browsers parse as strict XML, so `&` (not followed by a valid entity name) is a fatal XML well-formedness error — the browser silently discards the SVG and naturalWidth/Height are 0. The tag then rendered a blank frame (only the alt text was visible). Fix: replace `&` with `&`. Verified after fix: naturalWidth=400, naturalHeight=500, monogram renders with gold 'RS' letters on royal-blue background on both Home and About pages.
